{"file_path": "__WORKSPACE__/.dev/docs/design_draft.md", "content": "# Inventory low-stock alerts

* Author: test fixture
* Status: Draft

## Overview
Add an explicit in-memory low-stock check using Inventory.low_stock and an injected notification callback.

## The Problem
Repeated checks must not notify again for the same low-stock episode.

## Goals
Notify once while a SKU stays at or below threshold 5. Re-arm it after stock rises above threshold.

## Non-Goals
No background polling, network delivery, persistence or implementation in this fixture.

## Technical Plan
The checker tracks notified SKUs in memory and calls the supplied notification callback for newly low-stock items. A check removes recovered SKUs before processing current low-stock results.

## Alternatives Considered
Notifying on every call repeats alerts; persistent delivery is outside this fixture's single-process scope.

## Detailed Implementation Plan
A later approved task may add the checker and tests around low-stock and recovery transitions. This design-only fixture changes no Python source.
"}
